name: mlx-serve MCP
description: Bring Apple Silicon AI to your MCP clients — a stdio bridge to a remote mlx-serve inference server for images, speech, music, video and 3D, plus a full local toolset (files, shell, web, memory, scheduled tasks) and ready-made one-click prompts.
author: Congenital

changelog.1.1.0: Reimplemented on the official MCP SDK (FastMCP). Added the full local agent toolset: files, shell, background processes, web search/browse, persistent memory, and scheduled tasks. Generation tools now return media inline.
changelog.1.0.0: Initial release: stdio bridge to a remote mlx-serve instance for images, speech, music, video and 3D, with one-click prompts.

deploymentOptions.name: stdio (spawn)
deploymentOptions.description: The MCP host spawns the server; it connects out to your mlx-serve instance.

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Generate an image from a text prompt via the remote mlx-serve instance. Saves the image to disk and returns the saved path.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Model id (defaults to the configured image model).

tools.name: edit_image
tools.description: Edit an existing image with a text prompt (image-to-image).

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Model id (defaults to the configured image-edit model).

tools.name: generate_speech
tools.description: Speak a line of text aloud (text-to-speech). Saves a WAV and returns the saved path.

tools.name: generate_music
tools.description: Compose a piece of music from a style description, with optional lyrics.

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: Style: genre, mood, instrumentation, tempo feel.

parameters.name: lyrics
parameters.description: Optional words to sing (omit for an instrumental).

parameters.name: bpm
parameters.description: Optional tempo in beats per minute.

tools.name: generate_video
tools.description: Generate a short video clip from a prompt; muxed to MP4 via ffmpeg and saved to disk.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Optional WIDTHxHEIGHT or a ratio like 16:9.

parameters.name: seconds
parameters.description: Optional clip length in seconds (keep short).

tools.name: generate_3d
tools.description: Generate a 3D mesh (GLB) from a text prompt; saved to disk.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a file's contents, optionally a 1-based inclusive line range.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: File path (relative resolves against the working dir).

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Write content to a file, creating parent directories. Overwrites unless append=true.

tools.name: edit_file
tools.description: Edit a file by line range (start_line/end_line) or by exact text (find).

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Search file contents for a regex pattern; returns matching lines with file:line.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Optional glob to filter files, e.g. *.py.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List files and directories, optionally filtered by a glob, optionally recursive.

tools.name: shell
tools.description: Run a shell command on the host. Foreground by default; run_in_background returns a handle.

parameters.name: run_in_background
parameters.description: "true" to start in the background and return a handle.

tools.name: list_processes
tools.description: List background processes started this session, with handle and status.

tools.name: read_process_output
tools.description: Read the output a background process has produced.

tools.name: kill_process
tools.description: Stop a background process started this session.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: The process handle to stop (e.g. bg1).

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the web using DuckDuckGo and return the top results.

tools.name: browse
tools.description: Browse a web page: navigate, readText, extractText (CSS selector), readHTML. Browser-only actions report a clear notice.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: navigate | readText | extractText | readHTML | click | executeJS | screenshot.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: URL to load (for navigate, or to read a specific page).

parameters.name: script
parameters.description: JavaScript to run (for executeJS; needs a browser backend).

tools.name: save_memory
tools.description: Save a memory for future sessions (preferences, project context, important facts).

tools.name: recall_memory
tools.description: List all saved memories.

tools.name: clear_memory
tools.description: Delete all saved memories.

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Create a background job that runs a shell command, optionally on a repeating schedule.

parameters.name: goal
parameters.description: The shell command to run in the background.

parameters.name: schedule
parameters.description: Optional: omit/"now" to run once, or an interval like "every 5m" / "every day at 9am".

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: List background jobs created this session, with id and status.

tools.name: cancel_task
tools.description: Cancel a background job (stops a schedule / kills a running command).

prompts.name: portrait
prompts.description: Create a photorealistic portrait. Uses FLUX.2-klein-4B, the best model for faces.

prompts.name: poster
prompts.description: Create a text-heavy poster. Uses Mage-Flow-Turbo, the most reliable model for in-image text.

prompts.name: lofi_track
prompts.description: Compose a lo-fi hip hop track (instrumental) with generate_music.

prompts.name: song
prompts.description: Write and generate a short song with lyrics via generate_music.

prompts.name: short_video
prompts.description: Generate a short cinematic video clip with generate_video.

resources.name: status
resources.description: Live health of the remote mlx-serve instance (mlx-serve://status).

resources.name: models
resources.description: The model inventory with capability flags (mlx-serve://models).

resources.name: guidance
resources.description: Advice on which model to use for which kind of generation (mlx-serve://guidance).
